A new skeleton (Rhys's pick): par 37, 4 5 4 3 5 4 3 4 5. The first par 37 on any course, the first with three par 5s, the first that doesn't finish with a climb. Every hole from round 2 is kept, in a new order and a new place: Cycad Grove opens, the Floodplain 2nd, the Bone Bed 3rd, the Tar Pit 4th, the Swamp 5th, the Nest 6th, the Overlook 7th (now a par 3), the Strangler 8th, the Plunge Pool 9th (now a par 5).

The ledge moved to the east wall (Rhys's pick), 27 m up, with its ramp at the south end. From the south wall it was 1.4 km from the Great Falls; from here the 7th, 8th and 9th reach them in 1,005 yd. The ledge now stops cleanly at its ends.
The camp is on the floor, on a knoll west of the river behind the 1st tee. The old south ledge, Camp Falls, the old creek and the hollow pond are gone.

Nest Falls (Camp Falls renamed) pours onto the new ledge behind the 6th green; its creek cascades off the bluff beside the 7th tee, runs down the 7th's left and behind its green into the river (the Eden's trouble long and left).
The lookout (Rhys's pick): the expedition's timber platform on stilts, with a telescope and the flag, at the lip beside the 7th tee.
The rope bridge (Rhys's pick) spans the gorge where the river leaves the plunge pool, left of the 9th's approach: a frame for the finish and the walk back to camp.

The valley's features moved to the holes that use them: the back channel and its oxbow to the 2nd's second shot; the swamp's south edge pulled back, with two of its pools across the 5th's second leg; the tar pit to the 4th green; the Bone Bluff to the 3rd's corner (turned along the hole, 45 m long); the plunge pool a little bigger, the shelf on its south-east shore.

A fairway form for every par 4 and 5, chosen from its story: 1 fan, 2 broken, 3 island (the bluff in the fairway), 5 split (two stepping stones beside the dry way), 6 funnel, 8 split, 9 scalloped. Six forms, no two alike, none matching another course's.
Four classics, all new to the register: Long (2), Short ringed by tar (4), Eden (7), Leven (8).
Decisions, proposed: centre-line on 3, the long way round on 5, drivable on 8, go or lay up on 9. 1, 2 and 6 have one clear line. Each hole card says which; mark up the ones you want to change.
Helpers: a low bank between the 5th's pools and its dry way; the catch bunker on the 6th's low side.
The cards: the course card follows the cover, and a hole card heads every hole page (story, type and form, the feature and its job, the decision, the miss map, the tee view, the ground).
The tips tee (Brachio) is in the data on all nine holes, switched off: 3,670 yd, each spot checked for a level pad and a 290 yd drive on fairway.

Still to do: the 2nd and 5th are nearly level (they want 6–8 m); five greens have a feature (the rules want six or seven); the ledge's ends meet the wall in straight scarps; on the 7th, Raptor and Compy play from the floor below the bluff.
